names.note: Read out of saint.gr’s heading «Αγία Μαμέλχθα».
Read out of doxologia.ro’s line „Sfânta Muceniță Mamelta” for 5 octombrie.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2581, «Мамелхва Персидская, мц.», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr heads its entry «Αγια Μαμελχθα (; - 344)» and dates her dream «(344 μ.Χ.)». doxologia.ro prints no year.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 5 октября ст. ст. — «Мц. Мамелхвы Персидской (ок. 344).»
source.note: No rank is recorded. The one icon on the day above the plain service, «Совершается служба с полиелеем», stands before the synaxis of the hierarchs of Moscow and not before this line, and reading a polyeleos off it for the lines that follow would be an inference rather than the source's statement.

attestations.note: The year agrees with saint.gr's 344. The Russian adds the country the Greek entry does not, heading her «Мамелхва Персидская, мц.» — Mamelchtha the Persian.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs’s page for 5. октобар ст. ст. (civil 18 October) was not read (2026-09-17).
